sections.title: The Hippiatrika: Becoming a Veterinary Clinician II
sections.description: Hippiatrika II is the second in a series of four courses that take place in the fall and spring of the first two years of the curriculum. Named after one of the earliest collections of writings on veterinary medicine from the 5th and 6th century AD, the Hippiatrika series emphasizes the art and practice of clinical veterinary medicine, focusing on hands-on clinical skills as well as material associated with population medicine, One Health, communication, collaboration, professionalism, veterinary medical ethics, and regulation and finance. When applicable, course material is horizontally integrated with concurrent blocks.
